coder_notes: Registered phase is EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0/1b); translational subset. Eligible population is WHO grade 4 glioma with GBM named in conditions; no IDH requirement, 2021 WHO referenced in inclusion, so coded gbm_only with cns5 (could be read as historical grade 4 glioma). Levetiracetam is not a registered intervention but all participants must receive prophylaxis per eligibility text (listed per R9 rule on agents every patient receives). Standard-of-care fractionated radiotherapy is given in the Phase 1b expansion only. Phase 0 PK 'positive PK response' gates expansion; no pharmacodynamic endpoint.
